data.name: Elishua
data.gender_notes: Elishua is used as a male name in Christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Hebrew El, meaning God, and shua, meaning salvation or deliverance. In the Bible, Elishua is a prophet who is a deliverer and a man of God. The name Elishua carries the meaning “My God is salvation” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Hebrew, Greek. Parents who choose Elishua usually hope their child will grow to embody my god is salvation and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A symbol of divine intervention and deliverance.
data.etymology: Elishua belongs to the Biblical linguistic tradition and is used in Christian naming. Its recorded meaning is “My God is salvation.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Elishua total 3, giving a life-path number of 3. Number 3 is linked with Jupiter and with the qualities of creativity, expression and optimism.

in_hebrew.name: אלישוע
in_hebrew.long_meaning: אלישוע הוא שם עברי שפירושו 'אלוהים הוא המושיע שלי' או 'אלוהים ישועתי'. השם מורכב משתי מילים: 'אלי' שפירושו 'אלוהים' ו'שוע' שפירושו 'מושיע' או 'ישוע'. השם אלישוע מופיע בתנ'ך כבן של יהוידע, כהן גדול בירושלים (דברי הימים ב' 24:24). השם אלישוע הוא דוגמה לשם המשלב את האמונה באלוהים עם הצורך בישועה ומושיע.

in_greek.name: Ελισουα
in_greek.meaning: Ο Θεός είναι ο σωτήρας μου
in_greek.long_meaning: Το όνομα Ελισουα είναι η ελληνική μορφή του εβραϊκού ονόματος אלישוע (Elishua). Στη Βίβλο, το όνομα Ελισουα αναφέρεται σε ένα από τους γιους του Ιωαδά, αρχιερέα στην Ιερουσαλήμ (Β΄ Χρονικών 24:24). Το όνομα σημαίνει 'Ο Θεός είναι ο σωτήρας μου' ή 'Ο Θεός είναι η σωτηρία μου'. Στην Καινή Διαθήκη, παρόλο που δεν αναφέρεται άμεσα το όνομα Ελισουα, η έννοια της σωτηρίας μέσω του Θεού είναι κεντρική στο χριστιανικό μήνυμα.

in_latin.name: Elishua
in_latin.long_meaning: Nomen Elishua derivatur ex hebraico אלישוע (Elishua), quod significat 'Deus est salvator meus' vel 'Deus est salus mea'. In Scripturis, Elishua filius Joiadae, summi sacerdotis Ierusalem, memoratur (II Chronicae 24:24). Nomen hoc reflectit fidem in Deum ut Salvatorem et Redemptorem, quae est centralis notio in traditione christiana.

in_english.name: Elishua
in_english.meaning: God is my salvation or God saves
in_english.long_meaning: Elishua is a Hebrew-originated name meaning 'God is my salvation' or 'God saves'. It is derived from two Hebrew words: 'El' meaning 'God' and 'Shua' meaning 'salvation' or 'saves'. Elishua appears in the Bible as a son of Joiada, the high priest in Jerusalem (2 Chronicles 24:24). The name signifies the belief in God as the savior and redeemer, which is a central theme in Christian tradition. Elishua symbolizes faith, divine salvation, and spiritual protection.

data.cultural_impact: The name "Moses" is derived from the Hebrew word "mosheh," meaning "deliverer" or "saved." In ancient Egypt, the pharaohs believed that each newborn was the incarnation of a specific god or goddess, but in Moses' case, his Hebrew parents saw him as a deliverer from Egyptian slavery. Today, the name "Moses" is a common one among Jews and Christians, representing a trust in God to deliver and save.
data.spiritual_significance: The name "Moses" carries a deep spiritual significance for Jews and Christians, as it represents God's faithfulness to deliver and save His people. The story of Moses is a reminder of God's promise to be with us in our darkest moments and to lead us out of bondage towards a promised land.

historical_references.reference:
Elishuana, a daughter of Joram, who was king of Judah, bore a son to Jehoiada the priest, and called his name Elishu.
This Elishu was the successor of Joash, and reigned in Jerusalem over Judah.

(2 Chronicles 24:2-3)
historical_references.context: During the reign of Jehoiada the priest, Elishu was born and became the next king of Judah.

historical_references.reference:
Elisha, a prophet of the Lord, who was active in the northern kingdom of Israel during the reigns of Joram and Jehu.
He performed many miracles, including healing Naaman the Syrian with leprosy, and continuing the prophetic mantle of Elijah.

(2 Kings 5:8-14, 1 Kings 19:15-21)
historical_references.context: During the time of the divided monarchy of Israel, Elisha was a prophet who lived and worked in the northern kingdom and performed many miracles.
